description: Line parity of the Neuralese stages (owner 2026-10-11: the Mellum line on DGX and the LFM line on Pop use the same recipe, data and code; settings may differ only to fit, or where the backbone requires it, each declared with its reason). natlang_neuralese.train.line_parity checks it in scripts/check-main.sh --quick; plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md holds the audit. stages.<stage>.lines.<line>.recipe names the recipe of the line's NEXT launch and .active the leaf recipe of the lineage running now (its handoff chain; owner 2026-10-13: a key added to only one running chain must not go unnoticed); both are resolved fully (every leaf setting, runtime and continuation members included) and compared with the base. Each difference is a lineage key (lineage_keys), an allowed difference (fit-only or backbone-inherent, with its reason) or a dated line_specific entry {stage, lines, key|keys, reason, date, expires, recipe?}; an undeclared, expired or no-longer-needed entry fails; a direct-stage recipe that declares "parity": {"line", "stage"} is checked the same way, and the direct-stage runner refuses a fresh neuralese_direct or direct-artifact recurrence launch without a parity declaration.

acceptance.description: The shared E2E acceptance is the base recipe's e2e_acceptance (neuralese-e2e-v1; train/e2e_acceptance.py writes e2e-certificate.json; compared across lines as e2e_acceptance.*): consumers reading values (V) against consumers reading the gold tokens (T) on the same held producer calls, V CE at most T CE, V beats shuffled and zeroed blocks by 0.05 nats, at least 32 paired readers; exact-oracle task success, V at most 0.02 below T; base-relative drift report-only (owner 2026-10-15). Reported only: the 48-probe behaviour gate (owner 2026-10-12), the token-readout regression (eval/direct_token_readout.py, held-consumer arm, penalty 0.05 nats), the greedy-T arm. Runtime qualification of the exact starting weights is the lineage's first stage (direct_runtime).

line_specific.reason: historical one-off: Mellum's completed warm-up (runs/neuralese-direct-mellum-20261011/run-v3/direct_warmup, 333 updates, 0.5 epoch) used the 4962 full-prompt set (3,258 train documents, Mellum twin) while LFM's warm-up uses the union r2 full rendering (66k train documents). coordinator decision 2026-10-12 (agreed by Pop, pop-86dc): the finished warm-up is not redone; Mellum continues into neuralese-direct-mellum-v4's direct_sft and direct_trajectory on union r2. Not backbone-inherent and not a precedent: the parity recipe neuralese-direct-mellum-v4 keeps the r2 warm-up for the next fresh launch.

historical one-off: Mellum v4's direct_sft trained curriculum 0 to about 0.03 on the earlier allocation (direct_sft [0, 0.35]) and moves to the shared one (direct_sft [0, 0.75]) by an objective continuation at its next --handoff, from its value at that update; the shared nested-family objective joins there (ramp from 0.05, so from zero). A fresh parity launch runs both from update 0. owner decision 2026-10-12 (REVIEW_20261012 rec. 4: QAT ramps the stages actually reach, nested family reinstated in the running lineage, no restart). Shared mechanism (recipe objective_continuation, direct_sft.objective_continuation); a running LFM lineage without a curriculum takes it the same way, its curriculum then starting at its handoff update

historical one-off: the LFM QAD broad lineage's completed warm-up ran 0.015 epoch (~400 updates; Pop: matching the owner-shortened earlier warm-up) against the shared base's 0.5; finished, not redone. Open for the coordinator: whether the shared base's next fresh launch keeps 0.5 for both lines

Pop's in-memory prefix merging of the 365,784-document r3 program-header phase exceeded its discrete host RAM cap before any update (stream-header handoff), so the LFM direct_sft forwards each decision row on its own. Not fit-only: merged chains are weighted per decision inside one normalized window, so window composition and position weights differ. Coordinator 2026-10-13: merging stays shared; the bounded-memory merge (text_warmup.stream_merge_prefix_rows, same rows and windows) now serves the stage, and Pop's next LFM handoff drops merge_prefix_rows=false, then this entry is removed

lineage_keys_reason: identity of one running lineage, not a setting: its heads, where it resumes from (continuation checkpoint, identity check, monitor reference, the data it already consumed), its frozen package and container pins (runtime.package_code, repo_commit, image) and its output directory and evidence (outputs, lineage). A fresh launch on either line replaces them.
